faq.a: This course provides restoration and cleaning professionals with the practical knowledge to identify, assess, contain, and eliminate odour in residential and commercial environments.

courseJsonLd.name: Introduction to Odour Control and Removal Techniques
courseJsonLd.description: This course provides restoration and cleaning professionals with the practical knowledge to identify, assess, contain, and eliminate odour in residential and commercial environments. The focus throughout is on source elimination, not odour masking.
